semantic_scan_candidates.statement:
Let $K$ be a hyperbolic knot in $S^{3}$ and $\chi(K)$ the space of con-
jugacy classes of $\operatorname{PSL}_{2}(\mathbb{C})$ representations of $\pi_{1}(S^{3} - K)$. There is a distinguished
component of $\chi(K)$ that contains the discrete faithful representation coming from
the finite volume hyperbolic structure on the complement of $K$. Does this component
always contain an arc of representations to $\operatorname{SO}(3)$?

original_pr_named_queue.Findings: 2026-09-30: Separate review passed the distinguished-component normalization and source-obstruction audit. Known cone-angle/two-bridge cases are credited; arbitrary SU2 representations or sign-related SL2 components do not settle the general canonical PSL2 arc question. No full-resolution or novelty claim. Draft PR: https://github.com/AlecKriebel/Math/pull/35.

responses.reason: Known cone-manifold cases and finite-quotient normalization do not prove a compact-real arc on the chosen canonical component for every hyperbolic knot.
